example.title: Harmony Road Bridge, Harmony Road over Little Catoctin Creek

brief: Single-span, four-panel, pin-connected steel Pratt half-hip pony truss, 63 ft long with a 12 ft roadway, on reinforced-concrete abutments and wingwalls. Wide solid-web rolled chords and end posts with riveted gussets, slim rod ties and bottom laterals; latticed handrails with latticed intermediate posts run along the inside of the trusses; timber deck boards and curbs on mixed steel and timber stringers. A cast-iron plaque on the handrail lists the year, the county commissioners, clerk, attorney and contractor; yellow-and-black hazard boards mark the ends. Two-lane-wide blacktop county road passing farm buildings at the edge of a small village.

names.plate: 1918 · COUNTY COMMISSIONERS: H. ALDRICH, W. T. BOYER, S. KEMPF · CLERK J. L. MOSER · ATTORNEY R. HANLEY · F. E. DORSETT, CONTRACTOR
